preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership through transferOwnership)
Attacker must have some token balance to be blacklisted

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, first add the attacker's address to the blacklist using addBlackList(). Then call destroyBlackFunds() on the attacker's address. This will zero out the attacker's balance but also reduce _totalSupply, allowing the owner to later issue() new tokens to themselves, effectively stealing the destroyed funds. The exploit path is: 1. addBlackList(attacker) 2. destroyBlackFunds(attacker) 3. issue(amount) to mint new tokens to owner.
